_note: Every value in this file is your-input: design decisions made by the recipe author (v0.1 on 2026-10-02; requirements + lag_scenarios added in v0.2 on 2026-10-03). They are not records. See the recipe for the reason behind each.

requirements._note: v0.2 posting-requirements rule = the author's own G5 rule from the 2026-10-03 live run, written down. close_gap_years: a posting asking up to this many years more than mine is 'close' (quick apply); more is 'far' (network).

_live_hosts_note: Every host a --live run may open. Job-board hosts plus the company careers sites Greenhouse redirected to on 2026-10-03 (curl -L check). The code checks the starting URL's host; redirect targets are listed here so the recipe names them, but the code does not re-check them, and pages may still load scripts/assets from other hosts.

sweep._note: v0.2 unfiltered test set (your-input): which public boards to sweep and which postings count as 'software, US'. Boards = Massachusetts companies from the live run with public Greenhouse boards (Proven sponsors, plus Formlabs = Likely and SimpliSafe = no CSV row). Seniority is NOT pre-filtered on purpose.
